verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs show a related capability — from a feature-flag rollout you can 'see the session replays, events, and exceptions from the people who got the flag' (posthog-docs-6), and session replay is tied to synced error/console data (posthog-docs-4/26). However, no evidence explicitly shows a direct jump from a funnel drop-off step or a specific error event to the replays of the affected users. missing for 10: explicit funnel-to-replay drill-down feature, explicit error-tracking-to-replay linking, independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
